vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: bx-search
Version: 1.2.0

The bx-search skill is a legitimate integration for the Brave Search CLI (bx), providing web search and RAG grounding capabilities. The installation metadata and documentation point to official Brave Search GitHub repositories (brave/brave-search-cli), and the agent directives are clearly aligned with the tool's stated purpose. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is a wrapper for the Brave Search CLI and reasonably only requires the bx binary and a Brave API key.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the declared requirements: the skill needs the bx binary and BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY to perform web searches via Brave Search. No unrelated binaries or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run bx (context/answers/web) for web searches and documents how the API key is configured. It references the user's Brave config file locations (for storing the API key), which is expected for a CLI that stores credentials. The directive to prefer bx over the built-in web_search is explicit but coherent with the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md includes GitHub release URLs for download (reasonable). However the Quick Start shows curl https://raw... | sh and PowerShell iex from raw GitHub — piping remote scripts into a shell is inherently risky. Prefer the GitHub release assets or review the install scripts before running.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY is required and it is declared as the primary credential. The README explains three reasonable ways to supply it (flag, env var, config file). No unrelated secrets or high-privilege environment variables are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not request system-wide privileges. It will read/write its own config file in standard user config locations to store the API key, which is expected behavior for a CLI credential.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it claims: a Brave Search CLI integration that needs the bx binary and a Brave API key. Before installing: (1) review the install method — prefer downloading the GitHub release binary rather than running curl | sh or PowerShell iex on a remote script, (2) treat BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY like any secret: use an env var or the CLI's config file and avoid exposing it on the command line, (3) be aware that all agent web searches will be routed through the Brave Search API (your queries and extracted content will go to Brave), and (4) review the install script and binary (checksum/signature if provided) if you need higher assurance. If you have concerns about sending queries to an external service, do not enable this skill.
